lead: Two lines that belong together, the thing and what describes it: a person's name over their email, a subject over its preview, a company over its domain. The first column of a [DataTable](/data-table), a row of a list. It is a composition of [Text](/typography) and [Flex](/flex), so it needs no stylesheet.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: The title in bold, the description under it in the secondary color.

extra.title: Next to the title
extra.description: `extra` sits after the title on the same line: a Tag ("VIP", "You"), an icon.

link.title: A link as the title
link.description: A link has its own look: `strong={false}` leaves the bold off.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: TextPair has no slot of its own: it is Flex and Text, styled by their stylesheets.
